interactive.hover: Pointer is over an enabled control; never the sole disclosure of essential action.
interactive.focus-visible: Keyboard/programmatic focus with visible focus token.
interactive.disabled: Command/control exists but cannot currently execute; reason available when useful.
interactive.readonly: Value can be inspected/copied but not mutated.
interactive.loading: Operation/data pending; control prevents duplicate activation where required.
interactive.permission-denied: Capability exists but caller lacks authorization.
interactive.unavailable: Capability is not provided by current provider/module/context.

persistence.dirty: Authoritative editable state differs from last confirmed host save.
persistence.saving: Host save has started and not yet confirmed.
persistence.saved-newer-edits: Captured snapshot saved but later edits remain dirty.
persistence.save-failed: Last save failed; current edits remain dirty.
persistence.external-conflict: Underlying durable content changed outside current edit snapshot.

surface.permission: Resource exists/capability known but access denied.
surface.stale: Last-known content visible but freshness cannot be guaranteed.
